leadText:
Dr. Eve (Japanese: ホクト Hokuto) is a character of the day who appeared in The Ancient Puzzle of Pokémopolis. She claims to be extremely intelligent, saying that she got her doctorate degree when she was only nine years old, but this is left in doubt due to her rather arrogant and hasty personality.

An archaeologist, Eve took credit for uncovering the ancient lost city of Pokémopolis, despite the fact that and actually found it; it was located near modern-day Pallet Town. However, Eve soon learned that her discovery was much more complicated and dangerous than it seemed. After accidentally awakening a and , Eve was horrified at what she had done and feared that the two would destroy Pallet Town and the entire . Thankfully, a giant put the other giants to , and everything went back to normal.

Although Eve had been terrified at what happened, it didn't frighten her away from continuing to be an archaeologist. In fact, it made her want to study Pokémopolis even more than ever.

==Voice actors==
 

==Trivia==
In the Japanese version, it is said that Eve deciphered the ancient Pokémopolis alphabet at 6 years old.
In the English dub, Eve was given a French accent. 
Her English name may be a reference to the female lead in .
